{"answer":"The Grennel bog-moth overwinters at a depth of 1.6 metres, and its diapause ends with the season's first sustained ground frost (a thermal drop below minus 2.4 degrees Celsius).","citations":["overwinters as a fifth-instar pupa buried at
a depth of 1.6 metres in saturated lowland peat.","Diapause in *O. grennelii* is terminated by a single environmental cue: the season's
first sustained ground frost, which the pupa registers as a thermal drop below minus 2.4
degrees Celsius."]}
